correctness.rationale: A direct normal-supplement argument gives c-normal(W) iff W∩[V,H] is H-invariant. Coprime averaging proves V=V^H⊕[V,H], Maschke yields the invariant-full-flag criterion, and a graph-extension bijection gives the Gaussian shuffle recurrence. All quantifiers include nonfaithful, noncyclic, nonabelian coprime complements; 0-dimensional summands are covered. Independent exhaustive finite-group normal-subgroup checks and noncyclic action tests agree.

value.rationale: Exact all-dimensional enumeration solves a naturally motivated quantitative version of a 2026 c-normal Sylow-chain existence problem for a broad class of coprime semidirect products. The result yields sharp zero/existence and every-flag boundaries and a fixed-space-independent density, beyond routine computation of one arbitrary case. It does not purport to solve general finite-group c-normal enumeration.
